question: Does paired constructive-proof representation training improve a randomly initialized tiny causal language model beyond matched proof-as-text training?
primary: ordinary structural-holdout A/B likelihood accuracy, paired minus text-only, per size and seed
architecture_selection: discarded development-only throughput/overfit pilot; largest listed architecture projected below 65 percent of six-hour cap for recipient updates
checkpoint_selection: proof encoder and bridge: validation only; recipient: full fixed update budget
choice_controls: A/B options must have identical connective-tree skeleton, depth, connective counts and printed byte length; a Boolean countermodel refutes the distractor under the same premises
pretraining_audit_amendment: Before any main recipient training or test inference, a manual example audit found an answer-length shortcut in the first generated dataset. That dataset is retained as abandoned raw evidence; regenerate matched choices and repeat the disjoint development selection before freezing the main study.
acceptance: pipeline integrity and matched controls; report all outcomes including tie or decline; positive external reasoning is not required
scope: controlled propositional deduction with a small byte LM; no claim of broad reasoning or indefinitely sustained improvements
